title: Configure preview URLs with postMessage live preview
description: Set a preview URL expression and postMessage live preview mode for routable frontend content.
problem: Editors need to preview draft content on the real route before it is published.
summary: Set a relative `previewUrl`, prefer `previewMode: 'postMessage'`, and reserve token mode for routes that cannot receive browser messages.
intents: open live preview on the real route
